notes.title: Charles Version 1.9
notes.notes:
The last update before the launch! Thanks so much for following along and we're excited to show off the full experience. In the meantime, you'll notice some of the changes we've made, many more are behind the scenes in preparation for launch :)


 Changed how sensitive the note timings are. There is a 33% more generous margin of error!
 Overhauled arcade menu, added lots of opponents and changed how the decoration works
 Added keyboard scrolling for the arcade menu
 Revamped the cutscenes and dialogue potions of the game to look better
 Added more people to the credits! Thank you for filling out the feedback form :)
 Changed the night-time lighting outdoors
 Added some functionality for Charles to steer better at night, as long as you're going in the right direction

notes.title: Charles Version 1.8
notes.notes:
Getting very close to launch! Two weeks away! Most of the stuff we're working on is behind the scenes. Next week should be a bigger update than this one. :) 


 Credits are more verbose
 Changed the "Play" menu
 Fixed a bug where the wrong opponent would get chosen on Night 1

notes.title: Charles Version 1.7
notes.notes:
​Most of the work this time around was behind the scenes, but things are starting to become finalized. The cutscenes and dialogue stuff have been a huge undertaking. It's looking like we're going to change the way we display text in the game to address a few issues. We'll see y'all in a week for another small content update. Launch is just around the corner!


 Switched Smooth Samuel and Rotten Roger in the story mode
 Added Dialogues with the random bees that fly around. Try talking to them by pressing "E"

notes.title: Charles Version 1.6
notes.notes:
Hello again! A quick update for y'all. Still working on the big release, with lots of systems coming closer and closer to completion. The art and music are nearly done as well. A November 30th release date looks very strong.


 Added hard mode and easy mode for Arcade and Story!
 Changed the scoring system. Streaks/Combos shouldn't matter as much as before (they used to be the only thing that mattered basically)
 Changed the letter grade system on the recap screen
 Changed art on the title screen for better contrast with interactive elements
 Added a "quit to title" button in the options menu
 Added note trails
 As always, more work is being done behind the scenes. You'll see hints towards that stuff in the game as disabled content

notes.title: Charles Version 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello hello! Another medium-sized update. Lots of stuff going on behind the scenes, but some of it is also IN FRONT of the scenes. Here's a list of the stuff that was done this time around. We'll see you all next week for another update.


 Reduced CPU usage of the game by 50%
 Shrunk the overworld levels by 20%. This will make it seem like there are more bees and hazards without increasing the amounts.
 Added recap screen that shows the breakdown of your performance and your opponent's performance
 Changed how wrong-notes are displayed
 Added more flowers and pollen to all overworld levels
 Added a small cutscene when going into the hive after gathering pollen
 Upgraded visuals for boosting
 Disabled collisions with bees as an experiment, might bring it back in the future
 Lots of work in preparation for future content and full release, of course 😊
 Changed some timings on the notes, hopefully, the sync feels better now. Its going to be a bit rough until we get it right, but then its smooth sailing
 Fixed a bug with loading day 3 night time
 Other small decoration changes on the title screen
